items.title: Larry Gold interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, June 18, 2025
items.q: INTERVIEWER: My name is Monk Rowe for the Fillius Jazz Archive, and I'm very pleased to have Larry Gold with me today...

ctx.x: Larry was interviewed via Zoom on June 18, 2025 by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.

My name is Monk Rowe for the Fillius Jazz Archive, and I'm very pleased to have Larry Gold with me today, musician, arranger, composer, studio owner, and I'm going to describe you as the musical glue in a long line of hit records.
